description: Show one site against the excellence roadmap to the person, in the conversation: theme by theme, each item with the level the site stands at, its target, what the current level says and what the next one asks for, the initiative that must raise it, and the items below target with no initiative. Hosts that support MCP Apps (claude.ai on the web) display it; elsewhere you get the same content as text. It is the plain reference view, in the language that site reads the grid in: to build your own presentation, read get_excellence_roadmap. With several sites, pass matrix_id (the error lists them); to put the sites side by side, use show_site_comparison.

lang.description: Language of the grid texts (en, fr, es, pt, de…); default: the language of the site

matrix_id.description: UUID of the site (a matrix, from list_matrices); optional when one site only is on the roadmap

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

name: show_roadmap
title: Show a site roadmap
